hr-0b50cc21c0ebaf7f.inputText:
단안 얼굴 RGB 영상 · 전경 분리 · 추정 카메라·FLAME
RVM 마스크와 VHAP 얼굴 추적 사용
구동 시 학습된 아바타 + 목표 FLAME 표정·포즈·카메라
재조명 시 환경맵 교체
hr-0b50cc21c0ebaf7f.outputText:
FLAME 메시 삼각형에 결합된 Gaussian 머리 아바타
부위별 위치·회전 잔차와 재질 속성으로 RGB 렌더링
FLAME은 구동 사전 모델 · 최종 표현은 Gaussian
독립 메시 내보내기·머리카락 가닥 복원과 구분

sources.label: SAMIRA is explicitly named method for this exact title;personal monocular relightable Gaussian head,not a separatepaper or HRAvatar/FLARE identity
FLAME-triangle-bound Gaussian centers/scales/rotations inherit coarse tracked mesh motion;final Gaussian rendering,not verified texturedmesh export

UVPref/Pt current-minus-reference displacement,Fourierposition/displacement cues,pretrainedimagefeaturepyramid/gatedgeometry/AdaINFLAMEconditions;fixedsemanticmasks/groupedconvmods/aggregation/smoothing;sampleUVposition/rotationresiduals. Scale/opacity are learnedparameters,not dynamicresidualheadoutputs.

Albedo/roughness/specular/opacity/normals Gbuffer;two compactresponsefactors persemanticarea,range(0.5,1.5),maskweightedUVresponse sampling;diffuse irradiance/prefilteredspecular modulated before deferredPBR. Not full lighttransport/castshadow/interreflection solution.

Two-stage Adam training:initial30percent normals/response factors heldneutral then activated jointlywithmaterial/environment;RGB+lateperceptual,pseudoalbedoprior,mesh-normalregularization,FLAMEfinetune,Gaussian densify/prune withUVresampling. Relight byswappingenvironment withlearnedattrs/normals/responsesfixed.

Peridentity10epochs,singleRTX3090,no totalruntime/FPS verified;512squareRVMforegroundwhitebackground,VHAPFLAME/cameras;256squareUV;INSTA/HDTF/NerFace25identities,last450frames heldout. Baselines official schedules,not equaltrainingbudget.
Selfreenact heldoutimage metrics:INSTA SAMIRA30.50PSNR/.0307LPIPS vsHRAvatar28.62/.0403. HDTFL1*1.451vsHRAvatar1.446 showsnotallmetricsbest. Noclaim quantitativephysicalrelighting/surfaceGT.
Crossidentityreenactment qualitative,trainedsourceavatar drivenbyanotheridentityexpression;not newidentity generalizable reconstruction
Relighting/materialdecomposition qualitative;compactfactor calibration,not groundtruth measuredmaterial or allillumination guarantee

Explicitlimitations:monocular/templateguided,tracking/fixedUV/predefinedmasks,lip/eyelidmisalignment;compactdiffuse/specular response doesnotmodelcastshadows/interreflection/extremelighting;intrinsic decomposition underconstrained
Six authors;firstconfirmedv1Sep21 2026 06:18:27UTC,onlyoneversion,no confirmedvenue;paperCCBYNCSA4;ownproject/code/modelnotlinked onprimarypage

INSTA: LPIPS 0.0307 · HRAvatar 0.0403
동일 분할 사용 · 비교법별 공식 학습 설정은 다름
재조명·다른 인물 표정 구동은 정성 결과
모든 데이터셋·지표에서 우세한 것은 아님

전체 학습 시간·FPS는 확인되지 않음

sources.label: Six authors; v1 2026-08-13 18:22:08 UTC only. Exact title/arxiv one candidate. No verified earlier own conference/extension marker. TOG template header alone not verified venue acceptance/date. No official project/code/model link verified.

Single portrait LRM surface; largest hair component, bbox scale/translation then rendered landmark/IPD alignment to template bust with scalp; bust subtraction yields watertight hair volume. Face template not independently reconstructed output.
Six virtual views at 1024², texture-free render to LMM grayscale guidance; structure tensor direction, projected symmetric tensors handle sign ambiguity. Not measured multiview capture.
LMM labels parting and constrained areas; projected/merged part curves, inferred gathering regions, scalp template, remaining loose. Sparse semantics constrain flow not exact strand geometry.

Surface vertices+Poisson volume samples, kNN graph pruned at parting barrier; tensor surface diffusion, semantics resolve sign, oriented volume diffusion with scalp-normal boundary; conjugate gradient. Geometric diffusion not trained generative diffusion.
Scalp seeds advect until hair-volume boundary; gap-filling seeds in sparse interior traced bidirectionally to scalp and boundary; explicit strands.

Tripo3D+NanoBanana2; no task-specific training, pretrained dependencies still required. ~10k graph samples. Single GPU unspecified model,32GB; total20min=LRM3/LMM3/semantic3/diffusion3/tracing8min for50k strands. Abstract few-minutes wording not used for headline. Qualitative in-the-wild cases; exact evaluation N not stated.

Manual alignment then render input view; IoU.75 and Ori-Err32.6deg compare HairStep extracted orientations from rendered/input images. Not independent 3D strand GT or hidden-view quantitative validation. HairLRM/HairGPT visual comparison uses figures because no released code; not own prior-version assertion.

Curly/kinky interwoven topology and fine weakly captured details fail; braids futurework. Author claims/plausibility not physical GT. arXiv nonexclusive license, native Figure2 privately reviewed not republished; independent ImageGen explanation only.

meta.og:title: Neural Body: Implicit Neural Representations with Structured Latent Codes for Novel View Synthesis of Dynamic Humans
meta.citation_title: Neural Body: Implicit Neural Representations with Structured Latent Codes for Novel View Synthesis of Dynamic Humans
meta.citation_abstract: This paper addresses the challenge of novel view synthesis for a human performer from a very sparse set of camera views. Some recent works have shown that learning implicit neural representations of 3D scenes achieves remarkable view synthesis quality given dense input views. However, the representation learning will be ill-posed if the views are highly sparse. To solve this ill-posed problem, our key idea is to integrate observations over video frames. To this end, we propose Neural Body, a new human body representation which assumes that the learned neural representations at different frames share the same set of latent codes anchored to a deformable mesh, so that the observations across frames can be naturally integrated. The deformable mesh also provides geometric guidance for the network to learn 3D representations more efficiently. To evaluate our approach, we create a multi-view dataset named ZJU-MoCap that captures performers with complex motions. Experiments on ZJU-MoCap show that our approach outperforms prior works by a large margin in terms of novel view synthesis quality. We also demonstrate the capability of our approach to reconstruct a moving person from a monocular video on the People-Snapshot dataset. The code and dataset are available at https://zju3dv.github.io/neuralbody/.
